title: I don’t know what I should focus on first
questionDisplay: I don’t know what I should focus on first
body:
Purpose

  • Addresses overwhelm

  • Names the difference between urgent vs foundational

  • Prepares users for “not everything matters yet”

This ANA does

  • Explain why focusing on the wrong thing early causes frustration

  • Introduce the idea of foundational vs later skills

This ANA links to

  • A “first practice project”

  • Or a very simple wizard like “What stage are you in right now?”
